observedTests.name: Actual installed workflows

observedTests.name: Assets and current security
observedTests.observed: Provider/download hashes, complete installed-byte identity, current exact-main workflows and processed raw CodeQL results passed with zero open main alerts.

observedTests.name: Launch and data boundary
observedTests.observed: Individual Desktop and Start-menu targets verified. Only synthetic profiles were exercised; installed EXE tests are distinct from ordinary default-profile shortcut activation.
